jobs.title: Inventory Control Associate
jobs.via: via Frito Lay Jobs - Search Hires Today
jobs.description:
Job Description

Inventory Control Associates are an important part of Frito-Lay's distribution network, helping ensure products move efficiently through every stage of warehouse operations. In this role, you'll assist with receiving deliveries, managing inventory, fulfilling customer orders, and preparing shipments while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and operational performance. If you're motivated by hands-on work and enjoy working as part of a collaborative team in a dynamic warehouse environment, this position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to our daily operations.

What You'll Do

  • Receive and unload inbound freight, ensuring products and materials are handled safely and efficiently.

  • Pick, organize, and stage products for outbound orders according to established warehouse procedures.

  • Use forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material-handling equipment after completing required training and certification.

  • Relocate inventory within the warehouse and place products in assigned storage locations using proper handling practices.

  • Verify product quantities, labels, and shipment documentation to maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Participate in inventory counts, replenishment efforts, and general warehouse organization projects.

  • Assemble, wrap, and secure pallets to support safe storage and transportation of products.

  • Maintain a clean and organized workspace by performing routine housekeeping and safety inspections.

  • Comply with all company policies, food safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.

  • Work alongside warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation partners to meet daily productivity and customer service goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Flexibility to work varying schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as operational needs require.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and move warehouse products throughout the workday.

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform repetitive physical activities during extended shifts.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently follow established work instructions and safety procedures.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-focused work environment.

  • Prior experience in warehousing, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, or material handling is a plus but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse responsibilities throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in warehouse conditions that may include temperature changes, moving equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial equipment while following all workplace safety requirements.

Skills & Competencies

  • Commitment to safe work practices

  • Effective communication and collaboration

  • Reliability and personal accountability

  • Accuracy in inventory handling

  • Organization and time management

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving

  • Ability to adapt and perform in a high-volume warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, depends on skilled warehouse employees to keep products moving efficiently across its distribution network. As a Inventory Control Associate, you'll support the receiving, storage, and shipment of products while helping maintain safe, efficient operations and delivering the quality and service our customers rely on every day.

Q: Can work schedules change at Frito-Lay?

A: Yes. Schedules can vary based on the position, location, staffing needs, and business demand. Distribution, warehouse, and delivery roles may require flexibility, including early mornings, weekends, holidays, or schedule changes.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q:Are forklift jobs easy to get?
A: Fairly accessible — many warehouses hire with little to no experience if you get certified (a short course, often 1-2 days). Demand stays steady since most large warehouses/distribution centers need forklift operators.

Q:How long is a seasonal shift?
A: Typically 8-hour shifts, similar to regular part-time or full-time roles, though hours can vary by employer and season (e.g., holidays vs. summer).

jobs.description:
Forklift Driver

Steel service center with plant on south side of Chicago seeks outstanding and experienced forklift drivers. Candidates with at least two years of sit down forklift experience preferred. Ideal candidate will have experience handling steel coils and skids of metal sheets.

Position Summary

Under the direction of the supervisor, the forklift driver will operate the fork truck to move material within the plant and load and unload trucks.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure that fork truck is in good working order with daily pre-shift inspections; Report all equipment malfunctions to manager and/or maintenance immediately.
  • Maintaining safe work environment by watching out for foot traffic; following standards and procedures; complying with legal regulations
  • Accurately and promptly complete paperwork including logs and new location sheets
  • Prompt, daily attendance
  • Sweeping and cleaning up work area as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • Two years forklift operating experience preferred. OSHA forklift certification is a plus.
  • Regularly lift up to 50 pounds, including pallets and fuel tanks for forklift
  • Basic math, tape measure and micrometer skills required
  • Must be able to physically operate forklift equipment (climb up and down into cab, twist torso for 360 degree visibility, use arms to operate controls, etc.).
  • Successfully pass a pre-placement physical, pre-placement drug screening and employment verification
  • Excellent work attendance record, ability to report to work as scheduled and flexibility to work overtime as assigned.

Benefits package includes:

  • Hourly wage commensurate with experience
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Medical insurance with generous employer contribution
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Vision and dental reimbursement program, short-term disability and life insurance
Company Description

We're a thriving steel service center with three locations across two states.

jobs.description:
Shift Details

  • 9 AM start
  • Monday - Friday
  • Mandatory Overtime

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • 1 - 2 years related experience preferred
  • Previous material handling experience strongly preferred
  • Radio frequency (RF) scanner and/or voice to pick experience highly preferred
  • Ability to consistently lift 50 Ibs. and be able to bend, reach, stoop, lift and stand for entire shift of 8 hours or more required
  • Must be able to work overtime with little to no advance notice
  • Willingness to learn to operate material handling equipment and rotate into various areas of the warehouse
  • Work at heights up to 25 feet consistently
  • Adherence to site safety regulations including wearing required personal protective equipment such as steel toed safety shoes, and material handling equipment safety harness; accountable to Cardinal Health’s EHS as well as QRA policies and procedures.
  • Aptitude to work in a fast paced distribution environment while meeting hourly established distribution quotas and performance standards

Responsibilities In This Role

  • Responsible for cross-training in multiple areas of the warehouse including Inbound, ValueLink and Outbound
  • Receive large boxes on warehouse dock, scan product with RF scanner, and input product information into computer
  • Break down cases of product and operate heavy equipment to replenish warehouse
  • Utilize voice to pick system to pick large case items with material handling equipment or to pick small unit of measure items and place on cart
  • Palletize large items to skid and wrap for shipment
  • Pack small items in boxes
  • Drive material handling equipment as required by job duty. Example equipment in the facility includes: order picker (cherry picker), forklift, reach truck, turret truck, pallet jack, and walkie rider

What Warehouse Operations Contributes To Cardinal Health

  • Warehouse Operations is responsible for performing/controlling a combination of manual or automated tasks necessary for the receipt, storage, and shipment of product.
  • This may include functions of receiving, picking, packing, shipping, staging, transporting, storage, delivery, etc.
  • Also responsible for the efficient flow of products from the point of product receipt from vendors to the shipment of products (via prescribed service parameters) to a variety of internal and external customers.

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies acquired knowledge and skills to complete standard tasks
  • Readily learns and applies new information and methods to work in assigned area
  • Maintains appropriate licenses, training and certifications
  • Works on routine assignments that require some problem resolution
  • Works within clearly defined standard operating procedures and/or scientific methods
  • Adheres to all quality guidelines
  • Works under moderate degree of supervision
  • Work typically involves regular review of output by work lead or supervisor
  • Refers complex unusual problems to supervisor

jobs.title: Night Warehouse Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 1991, Testa Produce, Inc. is the successor entity to the original Dominick Testa and Sons.Testa Produce's roots date back to 1912, with founder Dominick Testa selling stalks of celery door-to-door out of a basket. The creation of the Chicago Terminal Produce Market provided a central selling location for years. As the restaurant industry evolved, so did Testa Produce. In 2011, Testa expanded yet again and moved into its new home: a 91,300 square foot facility to accommodate an ever-growing list of restaurant, hotel and food service customers. 

Essential Functions: 

  • Direct and manage day-to-day PM warehouse functions, order selection, and staging using WMS and RF scanning systems.
  • Oversee night loading assignments, ensuring proper pallet building, weight distribution, and adherence to USDA stacking guidelines (e.g., separating conventional vs. organic products).
  • Ensure strict product rotation using FIFO criteria to optimize inventory flow, minimize damage, mis-picks, and product waste.
  • Support and collaborate with the PM Dispatch and Transportation teams on daily tasks, route staging, and system-shipping orders to ensure accurate, on-time departures.
  • Reconcile orders prior to shipment, audit loads for accuracy, and maintain warehouse organization for maximum shipping accessibility.
  • Enforce Good Warehouse Practices (GWPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and strict food safety guidelines.
  • Inspect outbound vehicles and temperature-sensitive areas to prevent contamination and maintain strict cold-chain compliance.
  • Direct PM warehouse sanitation efforts to maintain a clean, safe, and orderly facility.
  • Lead and promote a strong safety culture in partnership with the Safety Department, conducting routine inspections, associate observations, and accident investigations to determine root cause.
  • Oversee material handling equipment (MHE) usage and maintenance, ensuring team members operate forklifts, pallet jacks, lift-gates, and ramps safely and correctly.
  • Ensure full compliance with company policies, food safety requirements, and OSHA/DOT standards.
  • Recruit, train, coach, and manage PM warehouse personnel, fostering high morale, top performance, and accountability.
  • Help maintain contingency protocols to eliminate business disruptions during night shifts.
  • Maintain, organize, written employee training, performance improvement guidance, and discipline records in coordination with Human Resources and General Counsel & CAO.

Competencies:

  • Start-Up Smart (willing to do what’s needed whenever and wherever needed)
  • Intellectual horsepower (highly analytical & strategic)
  • Highly resourceful (stretches people and money; compresses time)
  • Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills (high EQ)
  • Innovative and creative thinking (need fresh thinking)
  • Listening skills (listen first, then respond)
  • Complex problem-solving skills (create options, then coverage)
  • Organized and attention-to-detail approach (strong tactical execution)

Education, and Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain, logistics, management, or a related equivalent preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in a warehouse or distribution environment, with at least 1- 2 year’s experience in a supervisory/management role.
  • Experience in food, produce, grocery, or perishable-goods distribution strongly preferred.
  • Proficient PC skills in CRM and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems- Produce Pro, Microsoft Office (particularly Excel), and common E Mail systems.
  • Must be able to read, speak, and write English satisfactorily, bilingual a plus.

Compensation:

  • $ 85,000 - $100,000/Year (Based on experience)

Schedule: 

  • Sunday – Friday (Off on Saturdays)
  • Start Time: 6:00pm

Physical Demands:

  • Work in cold and wet cooler conditions for extended periods of time
  • Stand, walk, or sit for long periods of time
  • Occasionally lift up to 50lbs

  • Medical & Dental (75%/25%)

  • 401(k) with 4% Company Match – eligible after 1 year of employment
  • Weekly Paid

jobs.title: Air Logistics Warehouse Associate - Shipping & Receiving
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎

(Official Position: Air Logistics Warehouse Specialist)

Join Kuehne+Nagel's QuickSTAT team in Schiller Park, IL, where you'll help ensure time-critical consignments move safely and efficiently through our warehouse. This onsite opportunity offers a starting pay of $23.00 per hour and the chance to work in a fast-paced, quality-driven logistics environment.

How you create impact

As a Warehouse Associate, you will help ensure time-critical consignments and inventory move through the QuickSTAT warehouse safely, accurately, and efficiently. You will complete Goods In and Goods Out processes, prepare specialized temperature-controlled packaging solutions, and maintain the detailed documentation and quality standards required in a compliance-driven environment. In this role, you will:

  • Process incoming consignments and inventory through the Goods In process, including documentation review, product inspection, piece counts, weights, dimensions, damage checks, and system updates
  • Complete Goods Out processing for outbound shipments, ensuring documentation, shipment details, packaging, and required re-icing are accurate
  • Select and prepare temperature-controlled packaging solutions, including PCM, liquid nitrogen, and dry ice, based on shipment requirements
  • Select and prepare temperature loggers and GPS tracking devices from onsite inventory
  • Perform and document quality checks on reusable temperature-controlled packaging
  • Clean, restock, organize, and update reusable packaging inventory within the warehouse system
  • Load and unload vehicles manually and with onsite forklift equipment
  • Prepare consolidated consignments for transfer to other QuickSTAT facilities
  • Enter key shipment milestones and maintain accurate inventory and shipping records
  • Monitor the departmental mailbox for packaging bookings, shipment updates, and internal operational requests
  • Respond to telephone and email inquiries from internal and external departments accurately and efficiently
  • Identify and clearly communicate shipment discrepancies, inventory issues, and potential operational delays
  • Maintain warehouse hygiene, organization, safety, and compliance standards
  • Provide clear shift reports and handovers to ensure continuity between warehouse teams

What we would like you to bring

You are dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a hands-on warehouse environment where accurate documentation and careful handling are essential. You can manage assigned responsibilities independently after training while communicating effectively and contributing to a collaborative team. To be successful in this role, you should bring:

  • Previous experience in warehouse operations, shipping and receiving, inventory control, freight, transportation, or logistics
  • Familiarity with Goods In and Goods Out, inbound receiving, outbound shipping, or similar warehouse processes
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to complete manual and electronic documentation accurately
  • Experience working in a safety-focused, quality-controlled, or compliance-driven environment
  • Ability to manage time effectively, prioritize assigned work, and meet strict deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort managing operational email communication
  • Ability to work independently after training while supporting the broader warehouse team
  • Reliable attendance, punctuality, and a consistent approach to completing assigned work
  • Experience handling temperature-controlled, time-critical, life sciences, or specialized freight is preferred
  • Familiarity with cold chain packaging solutions, GDP requirements, or courier and freight operations is a plus
  • Computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office and warehouse or inventory systems
  • Ability to work in a physically active, non-climate-controlled warehouse environment and safely lift up to 49 pounds, with team-lift or equipment support available for heavier items

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel we strive daily to inspire, empower, and deliver not only to our customers, but also to our colleagues. We offer a dynamic global work environment with opportunities for excellent training programs and career mobility. Base salary is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes health and welfare benefits, a 401k retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, and incentive compensation for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, skills, job location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Kuehne+Nagel reviews pay ranges regularly to ensure competitive and fair pay based on industry market data. TD1

Kuehne+Nagel participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used to assist in specific processes [e.g. screening applications, interview scheduling]. These tools analyze information to support decision-making, but final decisions are made by human reviewers.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate (Pick and Pack)
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities And Tasks

The warehouse associate is responsible for the efficient handling and movement of goods within the warehouse or distribution center. They play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of the supply chain and maintaining an organized and safe working environment. The specific duties and responsibilities of a warehouse associate may vary from time to time depending on customer demands and the type of goods in the warehouse, but generally include responsibility of the following:

Order Fulfillment: Picking, packing, and preparing orders for shipment based on customer requirements. Ensuring that items are correctly labeled, packaged, and staged for delivery. Collaborating with shipping personnel to ensure timely and accurate order processing.

Inventory Management: Accurately receiving, inspecting, counting, and recording incoming goods and verifying them against purchase orders or invoices. Organizing and maintaining inventory using appropriate storage methods, such as shelving, bins, or racks. Performing regular stock checks and reporting any discrepancies.

Loading and Unloading: Safely and efficiently loading and unloading goods from trucks, trailers, or shipping containers using forklifts, pallet jacks, or other material handling equipment. Adhering to proper lifting techniques and safety protocols to prevent accidents or damage to products.

Warehouse Organization: Maintaining a clean and well-organized warehouse environment. Arranging goods in a logical and systematic manner to maximize space utilization and facilitate easy accessibility. Keeping aisles, storage areas, and equipment clear of obstructions, and ensure the warehouse floor is free of any debris and rubbish to allow for frequent cleaning with the powered floor scrubber

Equipment Operation: Operating warehouse machinery and equipment, such as forklifts, pallet jacks, hand trucks, conveyor systems, and floor cleaning equipment, following established safety guidelines. Conducting routine inspections and reporting any equipment malfunctions or maintenance needs.

Documentation and Record-Keeping: Ensuring accurate documentation of all warehouse activities, including receiving, shipping, inventory movements, and product returns. Recording relevant information in the WMS system or manual logs as required.

Quality Control: Inspecting products for quality, damage, or defects during the receiving and picking processes. Identifying and reporting any issues to supervisors or quality control personnel.

Safety and Compliance: Adhering to all safety guidelines and regulations to minimize workplace hazards. Following proper handling procedures for hazardous materials, if applicable. Participating in safety training programs and reporting any safety concerns or incidents.

Teamwork and Communication: Collaborating with coworkers and supervisors to achieve common goals and meet operational targets. Effectively communicating any issues, delays, or discrepancies to appropriate personnel. Supporting a positive work culture and contributing to a productive team environment.

Perform Any Other Related Tasks As Required By Management.

Area of work

  • A Warehouse associate works with the following assignments.
  • Planning of the daily work in the warehouse.
  • Planning of storage and quay areas.
  • Receive incoming goods.
  • Daily contact to colleagues, customers and business connections.

Qualifications And Competencies

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience with picking and packing orders is a must.
  • Large warehouse (Amazon, etc.) picking and packing experience is an asset.
  • Familiarity with warehouse operations and inventory management practices is an asset.
  • Physical fitness and ability to lift heavy objects (up to 50lbs) and perform manual labor for extended periods.
  • Experience operating warehouse equipment, such as forklifts, or pallet jacks, is required and past hands-on experience in operating very narrow aisle forklifts is advantageous.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in performing tasks and maintaining a clean and neat warehouse area.
  • Basic computer literacy for data entry and inventory tracking.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • knowledge of safety regulations and willingness to follow safety protocols.

Personal attributes

  • You implement Blue Water’s culture and strategy.
  • You are loyal to the culture and the strategy.
  • You are active in strengthen the culture, the strategy and the objective. You always follow the set goals and tactical plans from the board of directors, regional directors and immediate manager
  • You are expected to act safely at all times to ensure your own welfare and that of your fellow employees on the basis of the defined health & safety targets.
  • You focus on continuously reducing Blue Water's environmental impact on the basis of the defined environmental targets.
  • You are capable of adjusting your communication to the different types of personalities – towards customers, business connections, managers and colleagues.
  • You communicate with respect.

An exciting opportunity

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in a team of motivated and qualified specialists, in a company with a high focus on employees and a unique culture.

What We Offer

100% employer paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees. Additional benefits include a robust 401K, generous paid time off and values-driven, international culture.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now.

As we review applications, we plan to invite qualified candidates for interviews while the posting may still be active.

So if the position has piqued your interest, we recommend that you don't hesitate to send in your application.

For this role, visa sponsorship is not available. Applicants must have work authorization in the United States.

What We Do – Together We Create Solutions

Blue Water is a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. The company was founded in 1972 in Denmark, and today, Blue Water has over 2,700 employees at 80 offices worldwide. Every Blue Water office combines a strong global network with local expertise, and the company operates in various dedicated business segments.

jobs.via: via Frito Lay Jobs - Search Hires Today
jobs.description:
Job Description

Warehouse Specialist help drive the success of Frito-Lay's warehouse and distribution operations by ensuring products are accurately received, stored, and prepared for delivery. This role supports inventory flow, order fulfillment, and warehouse organization while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational efficiency. If you enjoy physical work, value accuracy, and thrive in a fast-paced team environment, you'll find rewarding opportunities to contribute to our supply chain every day.

What You'll Do

  • Accept inbound deliveries by unloading trailers and inspecting products for accuracy and condition.

  • Pick, sort, and stage merchandise for outbound shipments in accordance with warehouse processes and customer requirements.

  • Operate forklifts, electric pallet jacks, and other material-handling equipment after successfully completing required training.

  • Move inventory throughout the warehouse and store products in designated locations using established handling procedures.

  • Check product quantities, labels, and shipping documents to help maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Assist with cycle counts, inventory replenishment, stock rotation, and warehouse organization efforts.

  • Build, wrap, and stabilize pallets to ensure products are protected during storage and transportation.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by completing housekeeping tasks and identifying potential hazards.

  • Follow company policies, food safety guidelines, and warehouse operating procedures to support a safe workplace.

  • Coordinate with warehouse teammates, supervisors, and transportation personnel to meet daily shipping, receiving, and service objectives.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years old.

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on operational requirements.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and relocate products throughout the work shift.

  • Ability to remain on your feet for extended periods while walking, bending, reaching, climbing, kneeling, and performing repetitive physical movements.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow written and verbal instructions accurately.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented warehouse environment.

  • Previous experience in warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or material handling is helpful but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse duties throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment that may include varying temperatures, moving equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial vehicles and warehouse equipment while following established safety practices.

Skills & Competencies

  • Dedication to workplace safety

  • Effective teamwork and communication

  • Dependability and accountability

  • Accuracy in inventory and order handling

  • Planning, organization, and time management

  • Critical thinking and sound decision-making

  • Ability to perform efficiently in a fast-paced warehouse setting

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse professionals to help move products efficiently throughout its distribution network. As a Warehouse Specialist, you'll play an important role in receiving, storing, and shipping products while supporting safe warehouse operations, maintaining inventory accuracy, and delivering the dependable service our customers expect.

Q: How physically demanding are Frito-Lay production jobs?

A: Production and warehouse positions can be physically demanding and may involve prolonged standing, repetitive movements, lifting, bending, and working extended shifts. Employees are also expected to follow strict workplace safety procedures.

Q:How many hours is part-time at Frito-Lay?
A: Part-time roles generally run under 30 hours/week, though hours can start low and Frito-Lay is often quick to offer more hours to reliable workers.

Q:Does Frito-Lay pay overtime?
A: Yes — 71% of surveyed employees said they receive overtime pay for their role at Frito-Lay. Some part-time reviewers note overtime access can be limited.

Q:How often do Frito-Lay employees get paid?
A: Most reviews indicate Frito-Lay pays weekly.

Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description

 Forklift Operator

Alsip, IL

Compensation Includes

  • Starting Pay Rate of $22/hour

Overview

The Forklift / Material Handler has the responsibility of bringing raw materials safely to production floor and taking finished products back to the warehouse or loading them onto transfer trailers. This position reports directly to the Materials Manager/Shift Supervisor.

Responsibilities

  • Must be able to operate forklift and perform daily inspections
  • Must be aware of and follow all safety policies, including use of personal protective equipment, housekeeping, hazardous materials, etc.
  • Must be able to interface with all departments concerning the timely distribution of materials to production and movement of materials FROM production such as all boxes, pallets, finished food, roll stock etc.
  • Must be able to load and unload trucks
  • Any paperwork must be prepared timely and accurately and turned into the warehouse manager before end of shift
  • Load and put away product safely and efficiently
  • Operate forklift/clamp truck safely
  • Supply all necessary materials to all running lines for continuous production- roll stock, pallets etc.
  • Operate Compactor, bailer, shrink wrap machine
  • Assist in coverage of breaks
  • Normal housekeeping duties, trash removal, moping
  • Miscellaneous duties as directed by department manager or supervisor
  • Complete trailer transfer sheets for each trailer loaded accurately
  • Assist with all warehouse inventories as needed

Qualifications

  • Minimum of High School diploma or equivalent
  • Must qualify for forklift license / certification on site
  • Recommend prior one year experience driving a forklift, but can be waived with demonstrated proficiency
  • Ability to read and write in English
  • Ability to work with a minimum of supervision after the initial training period is completed. Typically training will be on the job training under the mentoring of the shift supervisor and train the trainer
  • Normal Dexterity Required
  • Ability to lift a maximum of 50 lbs. Infrequently
  • Good attendance and punctuality required
  • Ability to work well in a team environment & motivate other within the team

Company Benefits

 What You'll Get From Us Benefits

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

Community Engagement

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Training and Development

Chicago Role Highlights

At a Glance

  • New Opening: Part-Time Warehouse With Benefits — Part-time Hours Full-time Benefits

  • Company: UPS
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.

Rewards

  • Earn extra cash with a stable local employer.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

It sounds too good to be true — part-time hours with full-time quality benefits. But at UPS, it has been the reality for decades, and it is one of the primary reasons our part-time workforce has some of the highest retention rates in the logistics industry. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions with benefits are the rare exception in the American labor market — roles where Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision coverage, pension contributions, and paid personal time are available to associates working as few as 17.5 hours per week. When you search for warehouse jobs with benefits near me, nothing else on the market delivers what UPS does at the part-time level.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I took this job because my family needed health insurance and I could not afford individual coverage. UPS's Teamsters medical plan costs me a fraction of what individual insurance costs, covers my entire family, and is genuinely better coverage than what my spouse gets at their full-time job. I work 20 hours a week, I am home by 9:30 AM every morning, and my family's healthcare is completely handled. For anyone searching for warehouse jobs with benefits at part-time hours, UPS is completely in its own league." - Current Part-Time Associate with Benefits, Nashville, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Warehouse Associate with Benefits, you work a structured 3.5 to 5 hour sort shift inside our package center, performing the core loading, sorting, and unloading functions that keep the UPS delivery network running — and accessing a benefits package that most part-time employers do not even attempt to offer.

  • Core Sort Functions: Execute UPS's standard sort operation tasks — unloading trailers, sorting packages on conveyor systems, and loading delivery vehicles in sequence order — building skill and speed across all three functions over time on a consistent part-time schedule.
  • Benefits Enrollment Navigation: Work with UPS's onboarding team to enroll in Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision benefits, understand your pension accrual schedule, and register for the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program within your first weeks on the job.
  • Consistent Schedule Reliability: Maintain consistent attendance across your assigned part-time shift window — the foundation on which your Teamsters union seniority, annual wage progression, and long-term benefits eligibility are all built.

Benefits & Perks

This UPS part-time position includes the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and eligible dependents, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance covering up to $25,000 in education costs. Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.

jobs.title: Warehouse Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Warehouse Operations Supervisor

Location: Melrose Park, Illinois, United States , On-site

Employment Type: Full-time

Reports To: Warehouse Manager / Operations Manager


About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on and bilingual Warehouse Operations Supervisor to support and oversee daily warehouse operations. This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse workflows, resolving operational issues, improving warehouse processes, and ensuring stable, accurate, and efficient execution across inbound, storage, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.

This position serves as a key bridge between the warehouse operations team, internal technical teams, external vendors, and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate is highly responsible, operationally detail-oriented, bilingual in English and Mandarin, and comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.


Responsibilities

Warehouse Operations & Team Management

  • Supervise daily warehouse operations, including receiving, put-away, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.
  • Assign daily tasks, monitor workflow, and ensure operational productivity, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Lead, coach, and support warehouse associates and team leads in daily execution.
  • Partner with HR and warehouse management to recruit, interview, onboard, and train local warehouse employees based on staffing needs.
  • Monitor team performance, provide timely feedback, and promote a disciplined, accountable, and positive warehouse work environment.

Issue Resolution & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Act as the on-site point of contact for daily operational issues, escalations, and process exceptions.
  • Coordinate with internal operations, IT/system teams, equipment vendors, carriers, and 3PL partners to resolve operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot and follow up on system errors, scanner/PDA issues, label printer problems, equipment malfunctions, and other warehouse exceptions.
  • Track issues through closure and help implement preventive actions to reduce repeat problems.

Inventory, Fulfillment & Accuracy Control

  • Oversee inbound receiving accuracy, documentation verification, system updates, and inventory put-away.
  • Support inventory control, cycle counts, bin location accuracy, and discrepancy investigation.
  • Monitor picking, packing, labeling, and shipping quality to ensure order accuracy and on-time fulfillment.
  • Ensure carrier-specific and platform-specific requirements are followed, including FBA and other shipping/labeling standards when applicable.

5S, Safety & Process Improvement

  • Support 5S management, warehouse layout optimization, and on-site improvement projects.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, efficient, and safe warehouse environment.
  • Enforce company safety policies, warehouse procedures, and OSHA-related safety standards.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and propose practical solutions to improve productivity, accuracy, and workflow efficiency.

Data, KPI & Reporting

  • Track daily and weekly operational KPIs, including productivity, order accuracy, inventory accuracy, receiving progress, shipping performance, and exception rates.
  • Prepare operational reports and communicate key issues, risks, and improvement actions to management.
  • Review 3PL/vendor performance data and billing details when applicable.


Requirements

Basic Requirements

  • Authorized to work legally in the United States
  • Fluent bilingual skills in English and Mandarin are required; must be able to speak, listen, read, and write in both languages
  • Spanish language skills are a strong plus
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Automation, or related fields are preferred

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 2+ years of warehouse, logistics, fulfillment, or supply chain operations experience
  • At least 1 year of warehouse lead, supervisor, or team management experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of warehouse workflows, including inbound, storage, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns
  • Experience with WMS, scanners/PDA, label printers, warehouse systems, and basic troubleshooting preferred
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; ability to work with operational data and reports
  • Experience in e-commerce fulfillment, footwear/apparel, 3PL, or high-volume warehouse operations preferred
  • Forklift certification or forklift operating experience is a plus

Personal Attributes

  • Strong leadership, communication, and coordination skills
  • Hands-on problem solver with a strong sense of ownership
  • Detail-oriented, reliable, and highly responsible
  • Able to work under pressure and respond quickly to operational changes
  • Strong learning ability and willingness to improve warehouse processes
  • Comfortable working on the warehouse floor and communicating with both frontline employees and management teams

Physical & Schedule Requirements

  • Must be able to work on-site in a warehouse environment
  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 lbs as needed
  • Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, or peak-season schedules based on business needs

Benefits

  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Career growth opportunities within warehouse operations and supply chain

jobs.title: Forklift Operator - Part Time
jobs.via: via Women For Hire- Job Board
jobs.description:
Pay Rate: $20.58 per hour

Schedule: Mon, Weds & Fri 5pm - 11:30pm

The Forklift Operator is responsible for the safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, staging, scanning, and movement of freight. As certified forklift operators within the operation, they provide safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, movement, and documentation of cargo/freight within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, warehouse, or dock environment, directly contributing to productivity, workflow coordination, and freight integrity. As the most experienced team members without direct reports, they often assist with mentoring, guiding, and onboarding new Material Handlers and solving complex operational problems on the floor.

Responsibilities

  • Load and unload freight using sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks, along with other appropriate Material Handling Equipment (MHE), such as pallet jacks, carts, and dollies, and approved physical lifting techniques.
  • Move, stage, sort, and position freight between dock doors, trailers, and designated warehouse areas in accordance with operating procedures.
  • Pick, pack, and prepare items for shipping and delivery.
  • Assist drivers with loading and unloading activities following dock and safety procedures.
  • Label, scan, and track freight using handheld scanning devices and company systems to ensure accuracy and documentation integrity.
  • Identify damaged freight and promptly report issues, unsafe conditions, or equipment concerns to supervisory personnel.
  • Abide by all company safety policies, OSHA requirements, and PPE standards.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized dock environment, including work areas, tools, and MHE.
  • Perform tasks under appropriate supervision while learning equipment operation, safety protocols, and job procedures (for developing roles).
  • Support dock productivity, workflow efficiency, and overall operational goals.
  • Work assigned schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs.
  • Safely and accurately handle oversized, high‑value, or complex freight.
  • Assist with dock coordination, workflow management, and problem resolution.
  • Prioritize freight and coordinate task assignments, sometimes acting in a lead capacity (without direct supervisory responsibility).
  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert on dock operations, equipment, and procedures.
  • Train, mentor, and support the development of other Material Handlers.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

Qualifications

  • Education: High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED)/equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Valid forklift certification/licensure (or ability to obtain before operating equipment) required.
  • Experience: 3+ years of dock or warehouse experience required.
  • Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in English, verbally and in writing, to understand safety and operational instructions, work assignments, and freight documentation.
  • Ability to recognize numbers, labels, barcodes, and freight markings accurately, and to perform basic arithmetic to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.
  • Basic arithmetic skills to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.
  • Technology: Willingness and ability to learn and use basic computer systems, handheld scanners, and freight-tracking devices.
  • Equipment: Ability to safely operate material handling equipment (MHE) such as pallet jacks, dollies, hand trucks, order pickers, pallet riders, conveyors, dock plates, dock levelers, sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks (with company-assisted certification/training), and/or other specialized MHE as required by the site.
  • Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance.
  • Physical Demands: Extensive standing, walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and twisting for 8-12 hours per/shift, with the ability to lift, push, pull, and carry freight up to 50lbs without assistance, with occasional lifting of freight up to 75lbs with assistance or mechanical aids throughout each 8-12 hour shift, multiple times per/week.
  • Vision, hearing, and verbal communication skills sufficient to work safely in a noisy dock environment.
  • Environment: Ability to work safely around moving equipment, vehicles, and freight in a non-climate-controlled environment, including frequent exposure to temperature extremes (both hot and cold), occasional outdoor work and/or exposure to precipitation (rain, sleet, snow, etc.), regular exposure to moving equipment, vehicle traffic, exhaust, dust, and moderate to loud noise.

jobs.title: Warehouse Part Time Days Job at Lowes in Chicago
jobs.description:
Your Impact at Lowe's
As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock.
You'll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.
This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail.
You'll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs.
And when a customer or teammate needs help, you'll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.
How We Support You
Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals.
As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
* Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
* Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
* Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
* Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
* Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.
For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit
Your Day at Lowe's
You'll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace.
You may also assist customers in locating or loading products.
Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.
Key Responsibilities
* Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects
* Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets
* Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts
* Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping
* Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed
* Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks
Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include:
* Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders
* Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices
* Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues
* Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction
* Execute Delivery Readiness best practices
Minimum Qualifications
* High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable
Preferred Qualifications
* 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
* 6 months Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking
Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well.
To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we actively seek and encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.
Travel Requirements
This role does not require regular travel, but occasional travel may be needed for meetings, training sessions, or to support nearby stores.
- Working Conditions
Environmental factors vary by location.
You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions.
Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible.
You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.
Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume.
Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds.
Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed.
Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.
About Lowe's
Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion.
Lowe's employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers.
Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need.
For more information, visit Lowes.com.

We offer exceptional benefits and wellness programs for eligible full-time and part-time associates, tailored for many different lifestyles.

jobs.description:
Starting Rate of Pay: $22.77/ hour

Shift Time: 0500-1000, 1700-2200

Position Overview

Transport freight across dock area to/from trailers for loading to trailers.

Essential Functions

  • Perform freight handling using appropriate motorized and manual equipment, including but not limited to: forklift, pallet jack and hand truck.
  • Verify documentation matches freight description (e.g. type, weight, hazardous materials), using current electronic or manual system.
  • Secure freight inside trailers using appropriate tools and supplies (e.g. pallets, straps, rope).
  • Recoup/repair damaged freight when necessary.
  • Verify and complete required documentation and reports.
  • Assist customers with freight and freight documentation as needed.
  • Perform hostling duties if required.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.
  • Perform other duties as required.

DISCLAIMER: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent, preferred.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Prior experience in warehousing, freight handling and/or fork lift operations preferred.
  • If hostler/yard mule duties required, experience preferred.
  • Ability to count and perform basic math, with or without a calculator.
  • Basic written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to lift/carry hand freight of varying weights several times a week, to lift dock plates weighing approximately 100 pounds, and to open trailer doors requiring approximately 75 pounds of lift force, up to several times per day or more.
  • Ability to bend, twist, squat, pushing/pulling freight throughout shift.
  • Ability to work independently and/or as a team member.
  • Previous dock/warehouse experience preferred.

Working Conditions

  • Dock environment; exposure to varied weather conditions, exhaust, fumes, dust, noise.
  • Hours may vary due to operational need.
  • Frequent contact with service center personnel; fast-paced, deadline oriented.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Inventory Control Associates are an important part of Frito-Lay's distribution network, helping ensure products move efficiently through every stage of warehouse operations. In this role, you'll assist with receiving deliveries, managing inventory, fulfilling customer orders, and preparing shipments while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and operational performance. If you're motivated by hands-on work and enjoy working as part of a collaborative team in a dynamic warehouse environment, this position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to our daily operations.

What You'll Do

  • Receive and unload inbound freight, ensuring products and materials are handled safely and efficiently.

  • Pick, organize, and stage products for outbound orders according to established warehouse procedures.

  • Use forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material-handling equipment after completing required training and certification.

  • Relocate inventory within the warehouse and place products in assigned storage locations using proper handling practices.

  • Verify product quantities, labels, and shipment documentation to maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Participate in inventory counts, replenishment efforts, and general warehouse organization projects.

  • Assemble, wrap, and secure pallets to support safe storage and transportation of products.

  • Maintain a clean and organized workspace by performing routine housekeeping and safety inspections.

  • Comply with all company policies, food safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.

  • Work alongside warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation partners to meet daily productivity and customer service goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Flexibility to work varying schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as operational needs require.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and move warehouse products throughout the workday.

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform repetitive physical activities during extended shifts.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently follow established work instructions and safety procedures.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-focused work environment.

  • Prior experience in warehousing, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, or material handling is a plus but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse responsibilities throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in warehouse conditions that may include temperature changes, moving equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial equipment while following all workplace safety requirements.

Skills & Competencies

  • Commitment to safe work practices

  • Effective communication and collaboration

  • Reliability and personal accountability

  • Accuracy in inventory handling

  • Organization and time management

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving

  • Ability to adapt and perform in a high-volume warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, depends on skilled warehouse employees to keep products moving efficiently across its distribution network. As a Inventory Control Associate, you'll support the receiving, storage, and shipment of products while helping maintain safe, efficient operations and delivering the quality and service our customers rely on every day.

Q: Does Frito-Lay require background checks or drug tests?

A: Many positions may require a background check, and some roles may also include drug testing depending on the position and location.

Q: What benefits does Frito-Lay offer employees?

A: Depending on the position and eligibility, benefits may include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage, tuition reimbursement, and other employee programs. Certain positions may also offer bonuses or additional incentives.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q:Are forklift jobs easy to get?
A: Fairly accessible — many warehouses hire with little to no experience if you get certified (a short course, often 1-2 days). Demand stays steady since most large warehouses/distribution centers need forklift operators.

At a Glance

  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

About UPS & Our Culture

Friday evening through Sunday night — that is when the UPS weekend operation runs at its highest volume, and it is when our Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers earn some of the strongest hourly rates in our entire package center network. If your Monday-through-Friday schedule is locked and you are hunting for weekend warehouse jobs that actually pay well, offer union benefits, and leave every weekday untouched, UPS weekend shifts were designed specifically for you. We are one of the only employers in the logistics industry offering weekend warehouse jobs near me with full Teamsters union representation, meaning your weekend hours come with the same contractual protections and pay guarantees as any full-time role.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I have a full-time desk job Monday through Friday and I work UPS weekends to pay down my mortgage faster. The weekend differential on top of the union wage makes the hourly rate genuinely excellent, and I get my full weekdays completely untouched. In two years I have built a serious financial cushion on this schedule. If you are looking for legitimate weekend warehouse jobs near me that respect your weekday life, UPS is it." - Current Weekend Package Handler, Indianapolis, IN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handler, you work Friday evening through Sunday sort shifts inside our package center, processing the weekend's elevated residential delivery and pickup volume that builds throughout the week and peaks on Saturday and Sunday sort windows.

  • Trailer Loading & Unloading: Pull inbound packages from arriving trailers and build outbound loads in package cars and linehaul lanes, using UPS-approved stacking methods to maintain load quality standards across all weekend shifts.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers receive a weekend shift differential on top of the Teamsters base union wage. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance apply regardless of your part-time weekend schedule. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday. Your entire Monday-through-Friday schedule remains completely untouched.

The night shift unload is the most physically demanding and most financially rewarding entry-level position in the UPS warehouse network. Our Full-Time Night Shift Unloaders are the associates who set the entire sort operation in motion every evening — pulling packages from trailers at sustained speed so that the entire downstream sort, load, and dispatch chain can execute without interruption. If you are seeking full-time night shift warehouse jobs that pay a premium for working hours others avoid, reward physical effort with contractually guaranteed union wages, and open the door to one of the most financially powerful blue-collar careers in America, this is the opportunity you have been looking for.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

Full-time night shift warehouse jobs do not get better than this." - Current Full-Time Night Shift Unloader, Memphis, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Full-Time Night Shift Warehouse Unloader, you work an 8-hour overnight shift inside our package center, leading the high-velocity inbound unload operation that processes all trailers arriving during the night sort window and sets up the entire sort floor for the day ahead.

  • Dock Safety Leadership: Model UPS safety protocols — trailer chocking, dock plate seating, and heavy-lift team technique — for newer associates in the unload area, setting the standard that keeps the night shift injury-free shift after shift.

Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday.

Precision is the promise UPS makes to every customer, and our Quality Control team is the internal force that keeps that promise intact. QC Associates audit the sort operation in real time — catching misloads, verifying scan compliance, and inspecting load quality before a single truck leaves the building. If you are searching for analytical UPS warehouse jobs that reward a sharp eye and a methodical mindset over raw physical speed, Quality Control is the most intellectually engaging role on the sort floor. These are warehouse jobs that directly protect the UPS service guarantee and drive some of the strongest internal logistics careers in our operations network.

"QC work suits my personality perfectly. I am not the fastest loader in the building, but I can spot a misload in three seconds and I find the audit process genuinely satisfying. As a UPS Quality Control Warehouse Associate, you conduct real-time audits of sort accuracy, load quality, and scan compliance across the active sort floor inside our package center, catching errors before they generate service failures for UPS customers.

  • Misload Auditing: Systematically scan packages inside loaded package cars against the assigned route manifest, identifying any package loaded into the wrong vehicle and immediately correcting the misload before the driver departs.

About UPS & Our Culture

The twilight shift is one of the highest-volume sort windows in the entire UPS network, processing the enormous wave of packages picked up from businesses throughout the workday. If you are searching for UPS warehouse jobs that align perfectly with a daytime school schedule or a morning-shift primary job, our twilight sort operation — typically running 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM — is the ideal entry into one of America's most respected logistics careers. These warehouse jobs come with full union representation and real long-term potential.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The twilight shift fits my life perfectly. I go to class in the morning, work at UPS in the evening, and my tuition is being covered by Earn & Learn. The shift itself is fast and the team is incredibly motivated — everyone knows we have a hard window to hit and we go after it together. These are the best UPS warehouse jobs for students, hands down." - Current Twilight Warehouse Associate, Chicago, IL.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate, you process the peak commercial pickup volume of the day during the evening sort window. You will rotate through loading, sorting, and unloading functions as directed by your sort manager within our package center.

  • Commercial Pickup Processing: Sort the high-density commercial package volume collected from business pickups during the day, routing each parcel accurately onto outbound belts and trailers for overnight transport.
  • Multi-Function Rotation: Work fluidly across unloading, sorting, and loading assignments as the twilight sort manager redistributes labor to balance throughput across the facility's busiest evening hours.
  • Sort Accuracy Compliance: Maintain UPS's required sort accuracy rate by carefully verifying destination labels and barcode scans before releasing any package onto an outbound conveyor.

Benefits & Perks

Twilight Warehouse Associates receive Teamsters union wages with annual progression raises, medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition program. The evening shift window makes this one of the most student-friendly warehouse jobs in the market.

Job Description

Logistics Associate are essential to Frito-Lay's warehouse and distribution operations, helping ensure products move safely and efficiently from receiving through shipment. In this role, you'll support inventory management, order fulfillment, and product movement while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and productivity. If you enjoy hands-on work in a fast-paced environment and take pride in delivering accurate results, this position offers an opportunity to be part of a team that keeps our supply chain running smoothly.

What You'll Do

  • Receive inbound shipments and unload products, pallets, and materials from trailers and delivery vehicles.

  • Pick, stage, and prepare customer orders for shipping in accordance with established warehouse procedures.

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other powered warehouse equipment after completing required training and certification.

  • Move, organize, and store inventory using proper material-handling techniques and product rotation practices.

  • Verify product counts, labels, and shipping documentation to maintain inventory accuracy.

  • Assist with inventory audits, replenishment activities, and warehouse organization initiatives.

  • Build, secure, and prepare pallets to support safe transportation and product quality.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free work environment by performing routine housekeeping duties.

  • Follow all safety regulations, food safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.

  • Work closely with warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation teams to achieve daily operational and customer service objectives.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and move products throughout the workday.

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform repetitive physical tasks during extended shifts.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures and work instructions.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-oriented environment.

  • Previous experience in warehouse operations, logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or material handling is helpful but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse work throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment with varying temperatures, warehouse equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial equipment while complying with company safety standards.

Skills & Competencies

  • Safety-first approach

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Dependability and accountability

  • Attention to detail and inventory accuracy

  • Time management and organization

  • Critical thinking and problem-solving

  • Ability to succeed in a fast-paced warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse team members to support the movement of products across its distribution network. As a Logistics Associate, you'll play an important role in receiving, storing, and shipping products while helping maintain efficient operations and delivering the quality and service our customers expect every day.

Q: What is the difference between a Route Sales Representative and a warehouse role?

A: Route Sales Representatives visit stores, manage inventory, stock products, and maintain customer relationships. Warehouse employees focus on receiving, organizing, picking, packing, and preparing products for distribution.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q:What does a Frito-Lay warehouse worker do?
A: Warehouse workers load/unload trucks, pick and stack pallets, operate forklifts, and manage inventory of chips and snack products. It's physically active work involving standing, lifting, and moving product through the facility.

Q:How long is a seasonal shift?
A: Typically 8-hour shifts, similar to regular part-time or full-time roles, though hours can vary by employer and season (e.g., holidays vs. summer).

Capstone Logistics is a recognized leader in supply chain solutions, delivering services in freight management, warehousing, and final-mile distribution across more than 580 locations throughout North America. Supported by a committed workforce, the organization prioritizes dependable operations and consistent results. In the Product Picker and Packer role, you will support key warehouse activities and help uphold Capstone’s dedication to accuracy, efficiency, and high operational standards.

Role and Responsibilities:

As a Product Picker and Packer, you will be responsible for gathering, organizing, and preparing products for outbound shipments while ensuring precise order fulfillment. Your work will contribute directly to smooth warehouse processes and overall productivity.

  • Pick items from designated warehouse locations according to detailed order requirements.
  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment safely and efficiently.

  • Coordinate with team members and supervisors to improve workflow and overall efficiency.

  • Ability to operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and related equipment safely.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines.
  • Physical stamina to lift, move, and handle heavy items.
  • Basic understanding of warehouse safety procedures and standard practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using warehouse management systems (WMS) or order processing technology.
  • Forklift certification or previous experience operating similar machinery.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends or evening shifts when required.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly pay with overtime opportunities.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holiday pay to support a healthy work-life balance.
  • Career development and advancement opportunities within Capstone Logistics.

Capstone Logistics is dedicated to providing efficient, innovative, and cost-effective supply chain services across North America. The organization emphasizes safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement while fostering an environment that supports professional growth. Capstone values collaboration, diversity, and long-term career advancement, promoting a workplace built on excellence and shared success.
