jobs.title: Warehouse Part Time Days
jobs.description:
Your Impact at Lowe’s

As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe’s is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe’s associate, you’ll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe’s

You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects
  • Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets
  • Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts
  • Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping
  • Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed
  • Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks

Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include:
  • Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders
  • Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices
  • Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues
  • Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction
  • Execute Delivery Readiness best practices

Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable

Preferred Qualifications
  • 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • 6 months Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking

Lowe’s commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we actively seek and encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel, but occasional travel may be needed for meetings, training sessions, or to support nearby stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

About Lowe's

Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion. Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

  • Abide by safety protocols and guidelines to maintain a hazard-free workplace and prevent accidents.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate - Hiring Immediately
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Target takes pride in its top-ranking position among retailers in the US. Its aim is to make daily life for families as enjoyable and stress-free as possible with its superior product and service offerings.

Roles and Duties:

  • Respect and observe all safety regulations and policies to foster a safe and secure working environment for everyone.
  • Acquire the necessary skills needed to work in a high-volume warehouse by attending safety training sessions.
  • Perform various activities such as packing, loading, and shipping goods to support the distribution of items to stores and customers.
  • Maintain the accuracy of product processing to ensure successful delivery to our stores and customers.
  • Keep safety, swiftness, and efficiency at the forefront of handling freight and moving inventory during warehouse activities.
  • A clean and tidy work area is an essential component of maintaining a professional and competent work image.
  • Being punctual at work and carrying out assigned tasks with precision and timeliness are essential for job performance.
  • To sustain continuous improvement, it's essential to monitor and measure progress over time. This can involve tracking key metrics related to process improvements and identifying areas for ongoing refinement
  • Sustains a genial and cooperative attitude when working on tasks alone or with fellow team members.

Requirements:

  • Possesses the strength and endurance to frequently lift and transport items ranging from 35-50 pounds during a work shift.
  • Can move and transport items weighing up to 60 pounds occasionally during their work shift.
  • Carry out work duties that demand regular standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching actions.
  • A positive and respectful approach is crucial to succeeding in both solo projects and team efforts.
  • Possessing a sound understanding of rudimentary mathematical skills, including counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Proficient in reading and understanding product information on labels, tickets, and documentation.
  • After undergoing training, one can competently use computer systems and handheld devices without much supervision.
  • A significant component of having strong communication skills is the ability to articulate effectively and accurately
  • The ability to comprehend and follow safety procedures, practices, and instructions necessitates adequate proficiency in reading, speaking, and comprehending the English language.

Additional Requirements:

  • Knowledgeable about the safe use of all powered equipment, such as Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit Down & Standup Forklift, and can work at heights of up to 40ft as required.
  • Engage in work activities that entail being stationed on a mezzanine level, reaching a height of up to 40 ft, wherever relevant
  • Capable of performing duties in temperature-controlled settings, including refrigeration and freezing units, throughout the workday.

Benefits:

Eligible Target team members have the option to enroll in a comprehensive benefits package, but must also adhere to the applicable eligibility requirements and other stipulations.

Note:

Your chances of getting the Warehouse Operations position will depend on your fitness for either the Warehousing Worker or Warehouse Associate positions, based on your performance in the questionnaire and assessment during the application process. Below are the prerequisites for both roles, with access to extensive information on job duties provided by accessing the links at the end of this page.

jobs.title: Delivery Station Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Amazon Delivery Station Warehouse Associate

Job Overview

You’ll be part of the dedicated Amazon team at the delivery station – the last stop before we deliver smiles to customers. Our fast-paced, active roles receive trucks full of orders, then prepare them for delivery. You’ll load conveyor belts, and transport and stage deliveries to be picked up by drivers.
Basic Job Requirements

  • Be 18 years or older
  • Understand and follow instructions in English
  • Lift up to 49 pounds
  • View prompts on screens and follow direction for some tasks
  • Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  • Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  • Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  • Work in an environment with varying temperatures and moving vehicles
What You’ll Do

  • Receive and prepare packages for delivery
  • Use technology like smartphones and handheld devices to sort, scan, and prepare orders into delivery bags and vans
  • Build, wrap, sort, and transport pallets and packages
  • Receive truck deliveries of customer packages
Schedule Options

  • Shift Options. Early Morning and Overnight hours.
  • Weekly Hours. Full-Time (40 hours), Reduced-Time (30-39 hours), Part-Time (20-29 hours), Flex-Time (minimum 4 hours/week).
  • Schedule Flexibility.Choose from a Fixed or Flexible Schedule.
  • Overtime Opportunities. Your shift could be extended or reduced by additional hours based on customer demand and will be communicated during your shift.
What it’s like at an Amazon Delivery Station

Safety Your Workspace

  • Safety. Your safety is our top priority. We provide protective gear and all teams share safety tips daily. Our state-of-the-art facilities are clean, well-organized, and designed with your safety in mind.
  • Equipment.You’ll be operating and working around moving equipment—mobile cards, rolling cages, etc.
  • Physical Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
Work Conditions

  • Temperature.Climate-controlled facilities maintain temperatures between 60°F and 90°F in most areas. On hot days, temperatures can exceed 90°F and on cold days temperatures can reach below freezing.
  • Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  • Dress code.Relaxed and comfortable. Closed-toe shoes required. Protective safety footwear required in select areas.$110 Zappos gift code provided for your first day.
Why Youll Love Amazon

Compensation

  • Benefits.Many of our shifts come with a range of benefits that may include pay and savings options, healthcare, peace of mind for you and your family, and more.
  • Anytime Pay.You can instantly cash out up to 75% of your earnings immediately after your shift (for select employee groups).Learn more about Anytime Pay.
Culture

  • Inclusive workplace. We offer a variety of employee support programs and resource groups. Join us in making a positive impact through local community engagement initiatives and outreach activities that help strengthen the areas where we live and work.
  • Team environment. Work on supportive teams in a workplace ranked among the best in the world.
Career Advancement

  • Onboarding Training.Youll complete on-the-job training during your first few days. In some cases, your training schedule will match the shift you selected. In other cases, youll have a fixed training schedule before transitioning to your chosen schedule.
  • Career Growth.Weve pledged to upskill our employees with free training and development programs, plus tuition support for select employee groups.
How to Get Started

Begin Your Application in 3 Easy Steps:
  • Click “Select Schedule.”
  • Choose your preferred shift.
  • Click “Apply” to begin.
Need help?Visit our step-by-step application guide.
Accommodations

Were committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you have a disability and need an accommodation at any stage, from the application through your first day, were here to help.

To get 24/7 support, contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT) by calling888-435-9287. You canvisit our People with Disabilities website to learn more about the accommodations process.

Specific accommodation types can vary by role and needs. Examples include: Interpreting Services, onsite coach and service animals, Assistive Technology such as Magnifiers, Screen Readers, Refreshable Braille Display, and Speech to Text Software, ergonomic equipment, alternative headsets, and onsite mobility needs including wheelchair, walker, and scooter use.
Equal Employment

Veterans, military spouses, and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Air Cargo Warehouse Agent -ORD
jobs.description:
Take a Huge step in your career and join Worldwide Flight Services. WFS employs over 22,200 of the finest professionals in ground handling across a global network of more than 170 locations and 22 countries on five continents. A career with us opens up a world of opportunities to develop your existing skills, to learn new skills, and to experience working with different customers and cultures with the sole aim of always delivering a world-class service. WFS provides a full-service capability that includes Aviation cargo, Airline passenger, and Aviation ramp services. Our team of people is highly trained, highly skilled, and confident airport service professionals who are supported by local training and development. We are passionate, capable, and always willing to explore new opportunities presented by customers all over the world.

Air Cargo Warehouse Agent -ORD

About WFS

Join our Worldwide Flight Services family and contribute to the timely delivery of cargo shipment, business to customer delivery, and on-time flights while operating safely and securely. We perform at the highest level for our customers every day, and strive to be an exceptional leader in our industry with our teams of cargo, passenger, ramp handling, and technical service experts in 164 airport locations, 18 countries, and on 5 continents. Are you ready to take off on your next career with us?

Job Summary

The work of a Warehouse Agent includes the following: loading and unloading of cargo; the receiving, delivering, and physical handling of freight and company material, export at the designated docks, the completion of forms and messages related to and necessary for the performance of the designated locations of the functions described. May be assigned to perform routine cleaning of work areas, ramps, and facilities with or without powered equipment. May be assigned to assist in monitoring security of facility. Comply with WFS site security procedures for assigned warehouse and other operations. Remain cognizant of WFS staff, security contractors, and visitors’ activities and report security breaches, suspicious occurrences, or non-compliance with the site security plan to managers or via the WFS whistleblower program.

Curious to learn more about what we do, please click the link below:

https://jobs.wfs.aero/content/Day-In-The-Life-Cargo/?locale=en_US

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for moving air cargo within designated warehouse.
  • Load and unload cargo from pallets and containers.
  • Build up cargo for outbound flights.
  • Break down cargo from import flights.
  • Facilitate the loading and unloading of cargo to and from semitrucks.
  • May operate basic cargo handling equipment such as forklift, aircraft pallets and pallet jacks.
  • Check freight for proper piece count, weight, dimensions and documents as appropriate when accepting or delivering cargo.
  • Confirm Dangerous Goods (DG) have been checked within aircraft limits and Follow specific procedure for DG shipments when received, including when shipment is abandoned by consignee.
  • Ability to understand and react to verbal commands and safety warnings, with and without, assistance of sight or visual aids.

Minimum Requirements

  • HS Diploma, GED or Equivalent
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Valid driver's license
  • Ability to work rotating shifts including weekends (i.e., Friday, Saturday, Sunday), holidays, and days off.
  • This job is covered by a collective bargaining agreement of the Transport Workers Union (TWU), a labor union which requires joining the TWU and paying union dues.**

Preferred Skills

  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand the English language.

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions

  • Ability to lift up to 80 lbs.
  • Ability to work in all types of weather conditions as well as environmental conditions, i.e., jet engine fumes, vehicle emissions, dust, and jet engine noise.
  • Ability to distinguish colors, red, green, and yellow.

Perks & Benefits

  • Want your pay in advance? Access your pay when you need it through DailyPay app!
  • Are you a top performer who thrives on recognition? On the spot awards offered through the Awardco Platform including gift cards and more!
  • Need quality medical care? Multiple options for both full and part-time employees!
  • Want WFS Employee Extras? Travel Discounts, Pet insurance, Discount Shopping & More!
  • Looking to stay healthy and improve your life? Wellness Programs offered to all employees!
  • Want to invest in your future? 401k program offered!
  • Looking to grow and have a career with us? Opportunity for Internal Mobility and transfers available!

WFS is an equal opportunity employer committed to employment equity and inclusion. We accept applications from all qualified individuals.

jobs.title: Warehouse Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The 2023 US Best Managed Company Award recognizes companies that outperform their competition in the four critical areas of management: strategic planning, effective execution, culture, and governance/financial performance. As a recipient of this accolade, Coke Florida has distinguished itself as a leader among U.S. private organizations.

What We Offer:

If you are a full-time employee at Coke Florida, you are eligible to enroll in our Total Rewards Program and take advantage of its many offerings:

  • The all-inclusive plans for wellness consist of medical, dental, and vision coverage that aims to provide complete health support to the employees
  • The employer-sponsored 401K plan includes a healthy company match, ensuring employees receive even higher returns on their contributions
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • The company provides its employees with 11 paid holidays and a vacation pay for three weeks annually
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • EAPs may offer a variety of services, including counseling, legal and financial advice, substance abuse treatment, and referrals to community resources
  • Competitive compensation

The Winter Haven Coke Florida site necessitates a Warehouse Lead, and we are hiring for the first shift.

What you will do:

The primary responsibility of a Coke Florida Warehouse Supervisor is to oversee the storage and shipping of materials.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Assumes responsibility for a group of 25-30 warehouse workers
  • Developing a team requires coaching, guiding, collaborating, and enhancing the abilities of those who work together
  • Administer the regular functions of the storage establishment
  • Arrange Warehouse Team Members to Meet Demands of Facility
  • Dedicate a section of your storage area for the proper rotation of goods
  • Assist with the regulation of inventory levels and mitigate the likelihood of product loss
  • Oversee the handling and storage of goods during transportation and upon arrival
  • Secure company assets
  • Adopting cost-cutting measures can help organizations manage labor and OPEX budgets effectively

Attention to detail is essential, as you will be dealing with important information and sensitive client data:

  • The minimum educational requirement for this position is either a high school diploma or its equivalent, the GED
  • This role requires a minimum of two years' relevant experience in the warehouse or distribution field
  • Experience in managing both human and financial resources is a must-have for this position
  • Employers require candidates to possess leadership skills and have at least two years' experience in a warehouse or distribution supervisor role
  • The skill to manage a manual or powered pallet jack proficiently is a fundamental necessity for all individuals responsible for transporting goods
  • You must have forklift certification before starting your job

Having a broad range of skills, knowledge, and experience can make you an invaluable addition to the team. Expanding your expertise in different areas, such as marketing, data analysis, or project management, can show that you are adaptable, flexible, and capable of handling various tasks and projects:

  • Advanced Excel experience
  • Familiarity with the efficient management of inventory systems and aptitude with SAP software preferred

The role requires a significant amount of physical effort, which means:

  • The talent to repeatedly raise, carry, and position bulky objects weighing up to 50 pounds without any help is mandatory
  • The position demands that the individual has the strength to push and pull items weighing no more than 50 pounds. The tasks should be executed while bending at the knees, kneeling, squatting, and reaching at different levels
  • The competency to use manual transport equipment (e.g. pallet jack or hand truck) to move product loads repeatedly for a distance of at least 100 yards without any assistance
  • The skill to repeatedly take hold of and operate objects that come in various sizes and weights that require deft finger movements and coordination between the hands and eyes
  • The capacity to sustain physical efforts for prolonged periods of time is a vital requirement for individuals who are involved in jobs that necessitate continuous manual labor
  • Flexibility in Reading Small, Medium, and Large Print
  • Demonstrating the ability to stand for a minimum of 8 hours while at work, and potentially extending up to 10 hours
  • The requirement to walk a minimum of 4 hours during the workday
  • Frequently perform tasks within an environment that is hot and humid indoors
  • The aptitude to equip an auditory aid to comprehend directions delivered in the English tongue

Other details:

  • Job Family: Warehouse
  • Job Function: Warehouse
  • Pay Type: Salary

Coke Florida may update this job description at any time and assign further duties and responsibilities as necessary.

The employee's ability to perform the essential job functions to satisfaction is a prerequisite to employment at Coke Florida. The company may offer reasonable accommodations to disabled employees to enable them to perform their job duties, provided it does not cause undue burden.

All applicants and employees are treated with respect, dignity, and consideration irrespective of their background or identity.

G3 Enterprises Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Why G3?

G3 Enterprises is an industry leader in packaging, logistics, real estate and minerals solutions. Our diverse portfolio of businesses create a variety of opportunities for career growth. We believe in fully leveraging the talent within our organization, presenting employees with challenging work, opportunities for job rotations, special projects, and a changing landscape.

Apply Today! We Exist for You to Succeed.

Job Description:

Summary
Under minimal supervision, loads and unloads trucks, inspects incoming parts for freight damage. Moves
raw materials or finished goods and other commodities in specified locations of warehouse. Submits and
inputs data via keyboard, barcode scanner or written sheets to control inventory movement. Pulls raw
materials or finished goods cases using a Warehouse Management System (WMS) for inventory
transactions. Responsible for inventory count and labeling. Works independently between multiple
warehouses and campuses as needed.

Essential Functions
This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict
the tasks that may be assigned.
• Works on a broad range of direct and indirect tasks, from simple to complex, across multiple
campuses as needed.
• Loads and unloads various types of freight.
• Works within the Warehouse Management System to receive and ship loads (including Swisslog,
Softeon, SAP, etc.)
• Performs cycle counts through WMS reports on a frequent basis as required and supports
inventory control.
• Troubleshoots warehouse management system and inventory issues.
• Process outbound and inbound shipments and paperwork, are completed timely and accurately.
• Maintains all safety standards, 5S principles, GMP, and PPE requirements, Lean (where
applicable). Maintains a clean, safe, and orderly work area.
• Communicates across shifts to shift leader (and team, as applicable) to ensure proper work
transition.
• Conducts standard audits daily utilizing safety checklist, taking corrective action as needed (i.e.
checking oil and charging forklift).
• Records quality outcomes using established forms.
• Inspects inventory for defects.
• Demonstrates teamwork within a diverse team, working closely throughout each shift.
• Follows and practices all established Standard Operating Procedures.
• Supports and practices all established safety programs and policies.
• Maintains satisfactory attendance, to include timeliness.
• Responsible for understanding and complying with applicable quality, environmental and safety
regulatory considerations.
• Operates equipment to move goods/material handling
• Loads and unloads inbound and outbound inventory onto freight containers, cargo trailers, and
rail cars as needed by location.
• Operates multiple types of equipment such as floor scrubber, pallet jack, etc.
• Attends and participates in company committees such as Safety Committee.

Qualifications
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The
requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and ability required. Reasonable
accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Minimum Qualifications
• High school diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus 2 years of experience in material
handling and forklift driving; OR High school diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus
current Forklift Certification and 1 year of G3 experience in material handling and forklift driving.
• Ability to obtain FLD certification within 30-60 days of employment.
• Required to lift and move up to 50 pounds.
• Basic PC knowledge.
• Experience with handling various sizes of palletized product.
• Required to work 8 hours shift with the ability to work 12 hour shifts, day or night shift, on multiple
campuses as needed.
• Able to work overtime as needed.

Preferred Qualifications
• High school diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus current Forklift Certification and 4
years of experience in material handling and forklift driving.
• Experience with Clamp, Double fork, and Pull Pack Fork Lift attachments.
• Experience loading and unloading rail cars.
• Experience with electric stand-up lifts.
• Skilled in comprehending simple instructions, short correspondence and memos such as email.
• Experience conveying simple requests and needs to coworkers and management.
• Skilled in adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing.
• Skilled in maintaining a clean, safe and orderly work area.
• Experience with using company resources in a cost-effective manner.
• Experience reading and interpreting documents such as BOL, instruction sheets, safety rules,
operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
• Experience with working in a team environment

Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to
successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable
individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit on a lift truck and drive
in and out of vans and containers. The employee is occasionally required to handle or feel; reach with
hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and
move up to 50 pounds and clean-up any leaking or spilled liquids caused by broken containers that they
were responsible for moving. Specific vision requirements are peripheral vision, depth perception, and
focus adjustment.

Work Environment
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters
while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable
individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be occasionally exposed to outside weather
conditions, fumes or airborne particles, and toxic or caustic chemicals. The employee is frequently
exposed to moving parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. The work
environment may not be temperature controlled and potential exposure to natural weather conditions.

About UPS & Our Culture

Every November, UPS launches the most intense hiring surge in American logistics — and the associates who join us for peak season are the reason millions of holiday gifts arrive on time. Our Seasonal Warehouse Loader positions are the highest-earning short-term warehouse jobs available in any market during Q4, combining elevated base wages, overtime opportunities, and performance bonuses that standard-season associates simply do not access. If you are searching for seasonal warehouse jobs near me that pay competitively, hire fast, and can turn into a permanent career, UPS peak season is the clearest pathway we know of into one of America's most respected blue-collar employers.

If you want seasonal warehouse jobs that can actually change your life, start here." - Former Seasonal Loader, Now Permanent Associate, Dallas, TX.

Benefits & Perks

Seasonal associates who convert to permanent status gain immediate access to Teamsters union benefits — medical, dental, vision, pension, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance — making this the most career-valuable seasonal warehouse job in the logistics market.

Role Based in Chicago

Fast Facts

  • Employer: UPS (Hiring in Chicago)

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

About The Role

The Part Time Restock Driver will be responsible for retrieving inventory from both floor locations and up-stock storage for Product Transfers and deliver to the designated area for stocking or shipment. The Restock Driver is required to operate machinery following all safety rules and regulations.

Compensation And Schedule

$22.15 hourly

Saturday-Sunday (10AM - 6:30PM), Part-Time, Non -Exempt

Onsite: 16427 West Prologis Parkway - Lockport, IL 60441

What You Will Do

  • Operate material handling equipment needed to perform primary role i.e; Forklift, Cherry Picker, Reach Truck, Stock Chaser (Cart), Pallet jack, Scanners, Tablets and Company WMS.
  • Perform and complete daily safety inspection check list for all equipment used.
  • Maintain productivity minimum requirements CPH, and work with a sense of urgency
  • Retrieve inventory from up-stock and floor locations and deliver to designated areas
  • Operate barcode scanner and use warehouse software
  • Act professionally and remain focused while working
  • Safely operate all warehouse equipment
  • Follow directions of leadership
  • Perform cleaning activities as required
  • Maintain a safe and clean warehouse
  • Maintain a positive attitude
  • Additional responsibilities as assigned by management


What We're Looking For

  • High School Diploma
  • Must be in good standing with the company
  • Ability to read and understand pick tickets and labels written in English
  • Ability to use electronic devices
  • Ability to count, add, subtract, multiply, and divide numbers quickly and accurately
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to work independently without close supervision
  • Ability to prioritize assignments in order to meet cut off times.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds or more
  • Ability to learn or be trained on using power equipment: Order Picker, Reach Truck, Stock Chaser, Pallet Jack, Electric Pallet Jack, Forklift, etc.
  • Willing to perform other duties as required
  • Able to work overtime if required


PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT

Must be able to wear proper safety equipment (safety toe shoes, bump caps and safety vest). PPE is company-provided with a $100 stipend on safety-toe shoes after 90 days of employment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

In performing the job of a Restock Driver, the employee must stand and walk for an 8+ hour shift. Additionally, the position requires frequent lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching and handling of items up to 50 lbs. Moderate Hand-Eye coordination, near vision, far vision and hearing is required for the operation of warehouse machinery.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

  • The job will be performed entirely in the warehouse where conditions can range from warm to cool.
  • The job will be performed around warehouse machines and equipment with a moderate level of noise.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

S&S Activewear welcomes people of all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to creating a diverse culture and supporting human growth. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. We conduct business without regard to sex, race, creed, color, religion, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, military status, status as a veteran, or any other protected characteristic. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, promote, assign, transfer, and terminate employees based on their own ability, achievement, experience and conduct and other legitimate business reasons. S&S participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S. This job offer is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background check.

jobs.description:
Xpedient is a full-service third-party logistics (3PL) provider supporting a diverse client base across warehousing, transportation management, supply chain solutions, order fulfillment, and labor services.

Monday-Friday

8:00am to 4:30pm

Summary

Xpedient Logistics is seeking a dependable and safety-focused Tire Freight Handler / Forklift Operator to support warehouse and tire distribution operations. This position is responsible for loading, unloading, handling, staging, and moving tires throughout the facility using both manual material-handling methods and powered industrial equipment.

A key responsibility of this position is manually lacing and stacking tires inside trailers to maximize trailer capacity and ensure loads are secure for transportation. This is a physically demanding position that requires the ability to consistently lift and handle tires weighing up to 100 pounds throughout the shift.

The ideal candidate has previous warehouse or freight-handling experience and is comfortable operating equipment such as sit-down and stand-up forklifts in a fast-paced warehouse environment.

Roles And Responsibilities

Load and unload tires from trailers, containers, and other transportation equipment.Manually lace, stack, and arrange tires inside trailers according to established loading procedures to maximize available trailer space and maintain load stability.Consistently lift, carry, roll, stack, and position tires weighing up to 100 pounds throughout the workday.Operate powered industrial equipment, including sit-down and stand-up forklifts, safely and efficiently.Transport tires and other materials between receiving, storage, staging, and shipping areas.Stage inbound and outbound product according to operational requirements.Verify products and quantities during loading, unloading, and staging activities.Follow established loading, unloading, and product-handling procedures.Inspect powered industrial equipment before use and report any safety or maintenance concerns.Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and required personal protective equipment (PPE) standards.Communicate product discrepancies, damaged materials, safety concerns, and operational issues to leadership.Assist with general warehouse duties as operational needs require.Perform other duties as assigned.

Safety

Minimum Qualifications And Physical Demands

Previous warehouse, freight-handling, tire-handling, or distribution experience preferred.Previous experience operating a sit-down and/or stand-up forklift preferred.Ability to successfully complete Xpedient's required powered industrial equipment training and authorization process.Experience loading or lacing tires inside trailers is strongly preferred.Ability to work safely in a fast-paced, physically demanding warehouse environment.Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.Strong attention to safety, product accuracy, and proper material-handling procedures.Ability to work independently and as part of a team.Reliable attendance and punctuality are required.Consistently lift and handle tires weighing up to 100 pounds.Frequently lift, carry, roll, push, pull, stack, and position tires.Perform repetitive material-handling activities for extended periods.Frequently bend, stoop, squat, reach, twist, and climb as necessary to perform assigned duties.Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the shift.Enter and work inside trailers while manually loading and lacing tires.Safely mount, dismount, and operate powered industrial equipment.Perform essential job duties in a warehouse environment that may experience varying temperatures and noise levels.

Xpedient Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Xpedient offers competitive wages, insurance benefits (medical, dental, vision and life), paid time off and holidays.

jobs.description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

Your role at Clorox:

The purpose of this position is to lead and carry out all daily business-related activities associated with general plant operations and to act as the liaison between the hourly work force and management, and to provide innovative and sound tactical thinking to achieve the appropriate levels of operating performance.

Starting Pay Rate: $30.83 + $1.35 Shift Differential

Work Hours: 6:00pm to 6:30am

In this role, you will:

  • Coordinate daily work floor activities.
  • Plan and schedule the efficient operation of the loading dock.
  • Lead Distribution Department safety effort in support of plant performance goals.
  • Coordinate training and development activities.
  • Lead daily start of shift and end of department meetings.
  • Offload and manage bulk material inventory (soybean oil, vinegar, etc.).
  • Manage material flows to provide efficient operations.
  • Interface with supply vendors and the on-site dedicated fleet to service the department.
  • Lead timely problem resolution efforts.
  • Participate in quality audits as needed.
  • Support and troubleshoot palletizer machine performance.
  • Manage on-site recyclables and order pick-ups as needed.
  • Initiate timely communication flow through the organization.
  • Drive department improvement initiatives consistent with the plant strategy.
  • Perform any assigned duties that fall within the scope of this job as defined by management.

What we look for:

  • Minimum of 3 years experience in this department.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Exceptional multi-tasking skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills.
  • Using available information, demonstrate the ability to coordinate and prioritize in a manner that is most beneficial for plant operations.
  • Excellent training skills.
  • Ability to understand and use network computer applications and electronic mail.
  • Willingness to make decisions using sound judgment based off of available information.
  • Successful completion of training as identified on Technology Matrix.

Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive. Learn more.

Benefits we offer to help you be well and thrive:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous 401(k) program in the US and similar programs in international
  • Health benefits and programs that support both your physical and mental well-being
  • Flexible work environment, depending on your role
  • Meaningful opportunities to keep learning and growing
  • Half-day Fridays, depending on your location

Please apply directly to our job postings and do not submit your resume to any person via text message. Clorox does not conduct text-based interviews and encourages you to be cautious of anyone posing as a Clorox recruiter via unsolicited texts during these uncertain times.

To all recruitment agencies: Clorox (and its brand families) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Clorox employees, including any members of our leadership team. Clorox is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About UPS & Our Culture

Most warehouse employers demand experience before they will even interview you. UPS is different. We hire driven, motivated people and train them to be exceptional — no prior warehouse experience required, no resume full of logistics jobs needed. Our overnight sort shift is the single best entry point into a UPS career for first-time warehouse workers, career changers, and anyone who has never worked in a distribution center before. When you search for no experience warehouse jobs, you will not find a better starting line than a UPS overnight shift. We offer real Teamsters union wages, real medical benefits, and the kind of paid training that turns complete beginners into skilled operators within weeks.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I had zero warehouse experience when I applied. I had been working retail and wanted something with better pay and real benefits. UPS hired me on the spot, trained me completely on my first shift, and within thirty days I was one of the faster sorters in my area. The overnight differential on top of the union wage is more money than I made at my retail job working twice the hours. If you are searching for no experience warehouse jobs near me, stop looking — this is the one." - Current Overnight Warehouse Associate, Las Vegas, NV.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Overnight Warehouse Associate with no prior experience needed, you will be fully trained on your first shift and supported by experienced team leads throughout your entire qualification period inside our package center. Overnight shifts typically run 10:30 PM to 3:30 AM, leaving your entire day free.

  • Paid On-The-Job Training: From your very first shift, a UPS-certified on-job trainer walks beside you, demonstrating every method step by step — no prior experience required, no knowledge assumed, no worker left to figure it out alone.

Benefits & Perks

No experience is required to access UPS's full benefit package — medical, dental, and vision coverage through the Teamsters union, a defined-benefit pension plan, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program worth up to $25,000. The overnight shift differential adds significant income on top of the base union wage. Your days remain completely free. Weekly paychecks start from your very first week on the job.

jobs.title: Warehouse Recycling Processor – 1st Shift
jobs.description:
As a Warehouse Recycling Processor, you’ll help keep our distribution center sustainable by recycling Styrofoam, cardboard, plastic, wood and metal. In this role, you’ll oversee key processing tasks and ensure that recycling areas are clean, orderly and ready for more materials. You’ll also conduct daily equipment inspections and collaborate with leaders to resolve any issues.

What You’ll Do

  • Clean and process recyclable materials
  • Ensure all materials are processed efficiently with no quality defects or load rejections
  • Move and stage processed materials for loading into trailers
  • Load processed materials onto assigned trailers for shipment
  • Unload and sort transfer trucks returning from stores and delivery pads
  • Create accurate records of processed materials

Basic Qualifications

  • Able to stand, sit and walk for long periods of time
  • Able to lift up to 75 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation

What’s In It For You

We’re committed to helping our people thrive at work and at home. Best Buy offers a range of benefits to support your overall well-being and provide support as you need it, especially at key moments in your life.

Our Benefits Include

  • Competitive pay
  • Great employee discount
  • Financial savings and retirement resources
  • Support for your physical and mental well-being

Best Buy provides different types of leaves of absence (LOA) and potential pay sources to employees based on eligibility. The length of your LOA depends on your situation, where you live, your full-time or part-time employment status, and federal and state regulations. Intermittent or reduced-schedule leave is also available for certain medical or family care leaves. Paid time off (vacation or PTO) is offered to full-time and part-time employees based on work location, employment status, salary or hourly status (exempt/non-exempt), and years of continued or bridged service.

Certain roles, where market norms demand it, are eligible for various forms of incentive pay to drive performance and offer recognition for achieving financial and strategic results. For more information about our incentive pay plans, including eligibility, please refer to our Incentive Programs Summary.

For more information about benefits, LOA and paid time off, please refer to our Benefits Guide.

About Us

As part of the Best Buy team, you’ll help us fulfill our purpose to enrich lives through technology. We bring that to life every day by humanizing and personalizing tech solutions for every stage of life — in our stores, online and in customers’ homes.

Our culture is built on deeply supporting and valuing our amazing employees who make it all possible. We’re committed to being a great place to work, where you can unlock unique career possibilities. Above all, we aim to provide a place where you can bring your full, authentic self to work now and into the future. Tomorrow works here.™

Best Buy is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Stock Inventory Associate
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Adhere to all safety policies and protocols to establish a safe work environment.
  • Engage in safety training programs to enhance your performance capabilities in a swiftly moving warehouse environment.
  • Handle the packaging, transportation, and distribution of goods for consumers and stores.
  • Ensure the meticulous management of products for retail fulfillment and customer drop-offs.
  • Ensure the smooth transportation of goods and effective inventory handling throughout the warehouse.
  • Make sure your workspace is clutter-free, organized, and clean at all times.
  • Timely attendance at work is crucial, along with accurately completing tasks as scheduled.
  • Work on addressing issues to foster continuous operational improvements.
  • Express a proactive and polite attitude when carrying out responsibilities independently or as a team member.

Requirements:

  • Able to frequently lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Proficiency in maintaining an upright position, navigating, applying force, dragging, crouching, flexing, and extending during working hours.
  • Sustain a positive and professional approach whether in a team or independent work setting.
  • Core math competencies that entail counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Competency in accurately comprehending and interpreting information found on labels, tickets, and other product-related documents.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in operating computer systems or handheld devices with minimal supervision following appropriate training.
  • Proficient in expressing thoughts verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to understand, converse in, and interpret English to follow safety guidelines, policies, and instructions effectively.

Additional Requirements:

  • Proficient in following instructions and utilizing powered machinery safely (e.g., Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).
  • Experienced in working safely at heights of up to 40 feet whenever necessary.
  • Experienced in operating effectively in temperature-managed environments, such as refrigerators and freezers, over long periods.

Benefits:

Target team members may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, subject to plan terms and employment eligibility. Employees also receive a 10% Target discount, plus an extra 20% off select wellness products, including fruits, vegetables, healthy foods, activewear, and tobacco cessation products.

Note:

Based on business needs and role requirements within Warehouse Operations, candidates may be considered for either a Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate position. The specific job responsibilities for each role are outlined in the application process.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate I (M-F 6:00am - 2:30pm)
jobs.description:
Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

Warehouse Associates are accountable for accurately performing a combination of manual and automated tasks necessary for receipt, storage, transporting, picking, packing, shipping, staging, delivery etc. of product that may be hazardous, temperature sensitive, or of high value amid continuously demonstrating behaviors aligned with Abbvie’s attributes and values.

Responsibilities

  • Comply with all appropriate policies and procedures to successfully maintain training, safety, GxP, and governmental agency standards.
  • Ability to comprehend and accurately process paperwork in accordance with policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
  • Responsible for cross-training in multiple areas of the operation while maintaining a low level of quality mistakes.
  • Accurately receive and inspect inbound product/material for infestation, overages, shortages, and damages (OS&D).
  • Efficiently and correctly pick customer orders for shipment, ensuring that the correct number and type of product is picked.
  • Transfers and locates material/product to general storage areas or shipping locations.
  • Verify quantity, quality, labeling and address with the customer’s order to ensure outgoing shipments are complete and accurate.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED to ensure ability to accurately complete basic math calculations, read and understand training documents, product labeling and warehouse signage written in English.
  • Pass medical screening and background checks that may be conducted by local, state, and/or federal authorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
  • Self-motivated with ability to work in a fast-paced positive team-oriented environment, coupled with good multi-tasking skills.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft office products, general computer skills and RF scanners. Ability to comprehend and execute standard problem-solving skills and effectively communicate verbally and written.
  • Capable of lifting 50 lbs., and/or more with assistance. Able to bend, reach, stoop, climb, stand and walk for entire shift of 8 hours or more.
  • Operate various types of material handling equipment including but not limited to forklifts, hand tools and other devices operated in a warehouse environment while maintaining the highest level of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to complete assigned tasks.
  • Ability to work in an atmosphere range of 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F).

Additional Information

​Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​
  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​
  • This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law. ​

jobs.title: Shipping and Receiving Associate
jobs.description:
We have great opportunity for those seeking a new challenge, but also a fantastic place to work. Come grow with us!

SPS offers a competitive benefits package including paid time off, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, legal and life insurance, transit program, referral bonuses, pet discounts, EAP, and a 401K with company match.

Schedule: Typically Monday - Friday, 7:30AM-4:30PM/8AM-5PM (Flexes based on area assisting with)

What You Will Be Doing

  • Giving amazing customer service to our onsite operation by scanning/delivering/tracking/reporting in and outgoing business packages and mail (via UPS, USPS, Fedex, etc).
  • Assisting the onsite personnel in retrieving their packages and providing records management in person, by email, by phone, or similar methods.
  • Oversee the onsite business center, which may include: office supply stocking, assisting with copy/print orders, conference room setup up, pantry inventory, or light facilities.
  • Serves as backup to route driving roles, which provide delivery to onsite personnel for packages, pallets, etc.

What We Need From You

  • 3+ year experience in shipping & receiving, mailroom, route driving, or similar services.
  • Valid U.S. Driver's License, must be at least 25 years old to meet our standards to company car insurance, and have had license for at least 5 years.
  • A positive and professional attitude with a willingness to go above and beyond for our customers.
  • Previous material handling skills a plus, including ability to use motorized and manual equipment such as forklifts (in locations where they are needed), pallet jacks, and hand trucks.
  • Ability to perform the following types of physical activities: lift up to 50 pounds, push/pull to move equipment, bend/stoop/squat/kneel, and reach above shoulders
  • Background and experience working in a warehouse or loading dock environment, with exposure to varied weather conditions a plus.
  • Must be willing to be cross-trained to support all tasks required for that site, including, but not limited to: routes, receiving, mail services, shipping, floaters, freight coordination & logistics, loading dock operations, and customer service/help desk. Must be experienced with and able to troubleshoot issues regarding tracking software, secure lockers, and other tools & technology used by the SRM team. Must remain flexible and ready to support the needs of the business. In some field offices, Supervisors will collaborate with cross functional partners to support waste, secure waste, and eWaste programs.

Compensation

The expected compensation is an estimate, and the final offer will depend on skills, experience, location, and other job-related factors.

Vacancy Status

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Pay Range

$21 - $21 USD

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: An opportunity to enter a job that allows you to learn new skills or use a variety of them that may lead you to uncover other career opportunities.
  • Learning & Development: At SPS, we promote a work culture of learning so that you can develop to be the best at what you do.
  • We Recognize Talent: We offer a variety of recognition programs for all levels of employees.
  • Paid Time Off: Full time: Minimum of 80 hours/calendar year. Part time/temporary: Minimum of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked. PTO amounts may increase based on tenure and/or the assigned account. PTO allows employees to take approved time off for any reason.
  • Bonuses: Are available for employee and client referrals for current employees.
  • Benefit Offerings: Medical, Dental, Vision, HCFSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter Transit and Parking Pre-Tax Plans, Supplemental Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Program, Identify Theft Protection, Pet Discounts, Pet Insurance, Group Home and Auto Insurance, EAP, Short Term Disability, Life Insurance, Education Discounts, 401k w/ matching, and Entertainment Discounts.
    • Note: Please inquire with the Human Resources team for benefit offerings per role as regular positions that routinely are under 30 hours/week may have a different benefit offering.
About SPS

SPS is a global workplace solutions and business transformation company operating in more than 20 countries. Across North America, we help clients enhance workplace experiences and business operations through services including workplace support, physical and digital mailroom solutions, intelligent document processing, reception and concierge services, and other business support offerings.

Our clients include leading organizations across banking, insurance, legal, higher education, professional services, and many Fortune 500 companies.

At SPS we embrace the uniqueness of our employees and are committed to the fair and equal treatment of all people, applicants, and employees by promoting a culture of access, inclusion, equity and diversity.

SPS provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual and reproductive health choices, national origin, age, disability, genetics, military status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and/or any other status protected by applicable law.

To ensure a fair and authentic interview process, applicants may not use AI tools or any other form of real-time assistance during interviews. SPS team members may use transcription or note-taking technology solely to support accurate interview documentation. No AI or automated decision-making tools are used to screen, assess, or select candidates for this role. SPS uses the Greenhouse Applicant Tracking System to facilitate application management and recruiting workflows. jobs.description:
Yard & Warehouse Laborer – Tire Recycling

K&S Tire Recycling is hiring dependable, hardworking individuals to join our yard and warehouse team in Chicago Heights, IL.

This is a hands-on, physically demanding position for someone who is comfortable working in an industrial environment and wants steady work with an established, growing company.

What You’ll Do

As a Yard & Warehouse Laborer, you will help keep tires and other recyclable materials moving safely and efficiently throughout our facility.

Daily Responsibilities Include

  • Load and unload tires from trucks, trailers, and containers
  • Move tires by hand and with hand trucks/dollies
  • Sort, stack, organize, and stage tires
  • Grade and inspect used tires based on condition and quality
  • Move and sort other scrap and recyclable materials
  • Maintain organized tire and material storage areas
  • Assist with general warehouse and yard operations
  • Perform general cleanup and housekeeping throughout the facility
  • Work safely around forklifts, loaders, trucks, conveyors, and other moving industrial machinery
  • Follow company safety procedures and supervisor instructions
  • Perform other general labor duties as needed

Requirements

Physical Requirements

This is an active, physical job. Applicants must be able to:

  • Regularly lift, carry, push, and move materials weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Handle and move tires repeatedly throughout the workday
  • Stand, walk, bend, reach, push, pull, and lift for extended periods
  • Work both indoors and outdoors
  • Work in varying temperatures and weather conditions
  • Work safely in an active industrial environment around moving vehicles and machinery

What We’re Looking For

We Are Looking For People Who

  • Are dependable and show up to work on time
  • Are willing and able to perform physical labor throughout the shift
  • Have a strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Can follow directions and safety procedures
  • Work well as part of a team
  • Take pride in keeping their work area clean and organized
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced industrial environment

Minimum 1 year warehouse, tire, recycling, automotive, construction, landscaping, manufacturing, or general labor experience is required.

Benefits

Why Work With K&S Tire Recycling?

K&S Tire Recycling is a growing tire recycling company serving customers throughout the Midwest. Our operation keeps millions of pounds of tires and recyclable materials out of landfills and puts those materials back to productive use.

We value employees who are reliable, safety-conscious, hardworking, and willing to learn.

We offer accrued sick/vacation time.

We have 1st and 2nd shift positions available.

Compensation is $16-$18 per Hour USD

At Graphic Packaging International, we produce the paper cup that held your coffee this morning, the basket that transported those bottles of craft beer you enjoyed last weekend, and the microwave tray that heated your gourmet meal last night. We’re one of the largest manufacturers of paperboard and paper-based packaging for some of the world’s most recognized brands of food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care and pet products. We are committed to workplace diversity and offer compensation and benefits programs that are among the industry’s best to reward the talented people who make our company successful.

If this sounds like something you would like to be a part of, we’d love to hear from you.

A World of Difference. Made Possible.

OPPORTUNITY: We are a Food service folding carton manufacturing operation seeking candidates to join our Chicago IL team. We’re recruiting for multiple positions so be sure you review all of our job postings. This job posting is for a Shipping – Receiving associate with a pay range of $21.91 to $25.36 /hour plus shift differential and progressive pay increases. We continually encourage our employees to advance their careers through on the job training and job progression through our strong promotion from within program. We offer a wide array of benefits including, but not limited to, Paid Vacation & Holidays, optional Health, Dental, and Life Insurance, including health spending accounts and a progressive healthy lifestyle program, as well as 401-K with a company matching component and standard supplemental company contributions. Employees may voluntarily elect Pet Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance Programs, Purchasing Power, Tuition Reimbursement, Aflac, Lifelock Identity Protection, and Hyatt Legal Services. Tobacco Cessation and Employee Assistance/Referral Program, Uniform Service, Safety Shoe, and Safety Prescription-Eyewear benefits are also available.

JOB SUMMARY: The person who occupies this position is responsible for shipping, receiving coordinating traffic, warehousing inventories, communications and producing product and any other items as they relate to shipping out of or being received into the plant and warehouse locations.

JOB FUNCTIONS: Job functions include, but are not limited to the following.

A shipping material handler will spend approximately 70% of working shift on a forklift and 30% doing other shipping duties.

  • Know, understand and follow all plant and department safety requirements.
  • Maintain a safe and clean environment inside and outside of the facility.
  • Maintain equipment and do all required safety checks and cleanings as required.
  • Wrap loads and insure quality standards and checks are being completed this is insuring packing, wrapping, labeling and information is correct on outbound shipment of product.
  • Ship and Receive all product in and out of the plant location.
  • Insure all manifests, invoices, orders, shipping documentation, and forms are accurate.
  • Examine documents to insure outbound and incoming contents are accurate with paperwork of the shipment.
  • Prepare documents such as work orders, bills of ladings, packing slips and shipping orders.
  • Shuttle product from the facility to outside warehousing as need with accurate billing and documentation for accurate inventories.
  • Record shipping data such as damages, rejected trailers, discrepancies for reporting, accounting and recordkeeping purposes.
  • Determine shipping methods and procedures for safe shipment based on the material using shipping knowledge and procedures.
  • Deliver or rout incoming material or equipment to the appropriate departments.
  • Confer and correspond with representatives to rectify problems such as shortage of material, late trucks, quality issues and nonconformance to specifications. This will include but is not limited to the warehouse, other shifts, production departments, corporate transportation, quality departments, safety manager or any supervision of the plant.
  • Communicating with Supervisors, Peers and Subordinates to insure all issues are communicated properly.

jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic team as a Package Handler and become an essential part of our fast-paced warehouse operations! In this energetic role, you will be responsible for efficiently handling, loading, unloading, and organizing packages to ensure timely delivery and smooth logistics flow. Your proactive approach and attention to detail will help maintain safety standards and optimize warehouse productivity. This paid position offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in warehouse distribution, heavy equipment operation, and inventory management while contributing to a thriving logistics environment.

Duties

  • Safely load and unload packages using appropriate equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, clamp trucks, and RF scanners
  • Accurately pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment following specified procedures
  • Operate heavy equipment including cranes and material handling equipment to move large or heavy items efficiently
  • Maintain organized storage areas by stacking pallets and managing inventory with precision using inventory management systems
  • Follow safety protocols in accordance with OSHA regulations to prevent accidents and ensure a secure working environment
  • Assist with shipping and receiving tasks, verifying shipments against documentation and inspecting packages for damage or discrepancies
  • Support warehouse operations by performing manual handling tasks such as heavy lifting and load & unload activities

  • Demonstrated ability to operate material handling equipment including forklifts, clamp trucks, pallet jacks, and cranes; certifications are a plus
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, shipping & receiving procedures, and materials handling techniques
  • Basic math skills for counting, measuring, and verifying quantities accurately
  • Experience with RF scanners or other warehouse technology tools is advantageous
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks involving heavy lifting safely and efficiently
  • Knowledge of safety protocols aligned with OSHA standards to promote a safe work environment
  • Warehouse experience or supervisor experience is beneficial for growth opportunities in the role

This position is ideal for motivated individuals eager to thrive in a bustling warehouse setting. We’re committed to supporting your professional development while ensuring you work in a safe, engaging environment. Join us today and be part of a team that values energy, precision, and safety!

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company.
